Bundled third-party libraries (kept local so Jeda works offline):

- three.module.min.js: three.js r160, MIT License, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- trystero-nostr.js: Trystero 0.26.0 (Nostr strategy, bundled by esm.sh), MIT License, https://github.com/dmotz/trystero

- `qrcode-generator.js` — qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT), ESM bundle from esm.sh. Used for Ruang Live QR codes.
